source.description:
PROBLEM: Model tool specialist_resume exists and the host supports resume, but operators have no slash command: only fleet, fleet:reply, fleet:stop are registered. Amendment acceptance 10 requires reply, resume, and stop to remain possible while the inspector is closed. Resume is the missing third.

SUCCESS: A resume slash command (slash-fleet resume under the sibling vocab bead, or fleet:resume if the rename has not landed -- compose, do not fork) resumes a settled or waiting activation in place with a new instruction; unknown or disposed activation ids error cleanly; help lists the command.

SCOPE: Specialists repo only: the registerCommand block in config/pi-extensions/specialist-subagents/index.mjs plus unit tests. No host or runtime changes.

NON_GOALS: The vocab rename itself (sibling bead); resume semantics changes; inspector work.

CONSTRAINTS: Suite green, tsc clean. Cross-frontend parity for shared wording. Every dispatch under unitAI-beqby passes model_override opencode-go/muse-spark-1.3-contributor.

VALIDATION: Unit test: resume command reaches the host resume path; unknown id errors. Operator live check optional but recorded if done.

OUTPUT: Commit on a specialists branch, result recorded in bead notes.

SCRUTINY: low
source.notes: Rescoped 2026-09-08: resume command already landed via .6 commit 512b0ff5 (specialists:resume 1544 + fleet:resume 1549, tests cover success/unknown-id/usage, file 100/100 green). No separate .7 dispatch -- would duplicate registration. Remaining .7 validation: operator live resume check, folded into .6 pending operator check. Seconder on .6: PASS_WITH_PENDING_OPERATOR_CHECK. Reviewer covers both beads at lane end.
source.title: Operator resume command wired to host resume (amendment acceptance 10)
